name: Husham
overview: Husham, identified as a Temanite, is noted in Scripture as a successor to Jobab in leadership, reigning over his people after Jobab's death. His reign is briefly recorded in both Genesis and 1 Chronicles, emphasizing the continuity of leadership within the land of Temani. Following Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad succeeded him, highlighting a pattern of God-ordained governance during this period.
